This job is responsible/accountable for streamlining offerings to CSGs end customers.

Production optimization from a personnel perspective is a critical point and leveraging technology to ensure solutions adhere to customers SLA requirements for availability.

The incumbent is responsible for providing key support for their focused product / solution area to internal and external resources.
Support and maintenance of the customers production and non-production environments - including on-call support / work variety of shifts to include weekends, holidays or extra shifts/extended shifts or as needed.

Independently building and testing reliable and well-tested solutions and once released troubleshoot any issues, actively seeking out problems and solving them.

Test driven development, Agile development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, DevOps automation

Troubleshooting and bug fixing for solutions once in place.
